name: 6-CARD BRAG
description: 6-Card Brag is a complex partition and vying game that bridges the gap between standard Brag and 9-Card Brag. Every player is dealt six cards and must divide them into two independent three-card hands. These hands are typically played against opponents in sequence (front and back) or used to decide a single highest-rank winner. It rewards both the skill of hand optimization and the traditional bluffing and blind-betting mechanics of the Brag family.

content.text: 6-Card Brag is a complex partition and vying game that bridges the gap between standard Brag and 9-Card Brag. Every player is dealt six cards and must divide them into two independent three-card hands. These hands are typically played against opponents in sequence (front and back) or used to decide a single highest-rank winner. It rewards both the skill of hand optimization and the traditional bluffing and blind-betting mechanics of the Brag family.
Developed as a strategic expansion of British pub Brag, 6-Card Brag introduces the 'partition' mechanic found in Asian games like Chinese Poker but retains the core British vying structure.
Standard pack, betting chips or currency.
Ante into pot. Deal six cards face-down to each player. Players divide their six cards into two separate three-card hands.
